positioning.title: How we approach AI
paragraphs: The value of AI in semiconductor manufacturing comes from turning sensor, metrology and inspection data into decisions you can act on.
BETTER treats published industry and academic architectures as benchmarks, then selects the method that suits each process scenario.
The architectures and quantitative results listed below come from third-party research, used as technical reference benchmarks and not measurements of our own.

entries.text: Generative methods and inverse lithography correction address patterning and optical proximity effects.

delivery.title: Five steps to deployment
delivery.lead: From scope definition to team handover, with verifiable metrics.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Define the problem scenario and quantifiable targets, then assess data availability and the value of deployment.

steps.title: Data integration
steps.text: Consolidate tool sensor, process metrology and inspection data into one consistent data format.

steps.title: Model deployment
steps.text: Select and tune the benchmark architecture that fits the scenario, then build the training and inference flow.

steps.title: Validation
steps.text: Compare against the baseline on agreed metrics and confirm stability and repeatability.

steps.title: Training
steps.text: Hand over operating and interpretation methods so your team can run and maintain the system.
